$comment: About how long each browser test file takes on one of GitHub's machines (seconds, one test at a time; the sum of each file's tests in the last green run, the pull request run of Nov 28, 2026, 16:33 UTC). tools/test-plan.mjs splits the files among the machines with it so they finish together. A file not listed counts 60 s. Update a number when a file's time changes a lot (the CI log prints each test's time). The four sequence tests of Nov 28 (signal, new-run, save-interrupted, update) are estimates from the build machine, times 1.3, until a green run measures them.
